articles.summary: SANTA CLARA, Calif., Sept. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Applied Materials, Inc. today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.53 per share payable on the company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on Dec. 10, 2026 to shareholders of record as of Nov.
articles.title: Applied Materials Announces Cash Dividend
